name: visa_draft_cover_letter
description: Draft a personalised cover letter for a France Schengen visa application. Follows the 30-second-skimmable format: purpose and dates up front, funding and accommodation in the middle, ties to home and commitment to return at the close.

accommodation.description: Hotel name + booking reference, or host details

funding_source.description: Who is funding: self, employer, sponsor

ties_to_home.description: Evidence of ties: property, job, family, studies
